name: contextdeck
description: One local canvas for every AI coding agent session (Claude Code, Codex, and more). Search, organise and resume your context windows across tools.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node bin/contextdeck.js --home .demo --claude-dir fixtures/claude --codex-dir fixtures/codex --qwen-dir fixtures/qwen index && node bin/contextdeck.js --home .demo --claude-dir fixtures/claude --codex-dir fixtures/codex --qwen-dir fixtures/qwen list
scripts.demo:ui: npm run build && node scripts/demo-data.mjs .demo-data && node bin/contextdeck.js ui --home .demo-ui --claude-dir .demo-data/claude --codex-dir .demo-data/codex --qwen-dir .demo-data/qwen
